translations.web: if anyone is blameless, the husband of one wife, having children who believe, who are not accused of loose or unruly behavior.
translations.bsb: An elder must be blameless, the husband of but one wife, having children who are believers and who are not open to accusation of indiscretion or insubordination.
translations.kjv: If any be blameless, the husband of one wife, having faithful children not accused of riot or unruly.
translations.asv: if any man is blameless, the husband of one wife, having children that believe, who are not accused of riot or unruly.
